translations.web: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
translations.bsb: The LORD was also angry with me on your account, and He said, “Not even you shall enter the land.
translations.kjv: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
